SELECT -- 需求统计（demand_input_summary确认存在） (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand_input_summary WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) as total_demands,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand_input_summary WHERE status IN ('1','2') AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) as allocated_demands,
-- 需求满足率 CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand_input_summary WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) > 0 THEN ROUND( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand_input_summary WHERE status IN ('1','2') AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand_input_summary WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})), 2) ELSE 0 END as demand_satisfaction_rate,
-- 分配完成率 (使用t_zone_allocation) CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_zone_allocation WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) > 0 THEN ROUND( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_zone_allocation WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_zone_allocation WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})), 2) ELSE 0 END as allocation_completion_rate,
-- 总分发量/农民领用量暂用默认值（表可能不存在） 0 as total_distributed, 0 as farmer_received, 0 as circulation_arrival_rate,
-- 认证供应商数 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM supplier_cert WHERE status = 2 AND del_flag = '0') as certified_suppliers,
-- 待审核供应商数 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM supplier_cert WHERE status = 1 AND del_flag = '0') as pending_suppliers,
-- 活跃仓库数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_warehouse WHERE status = '1' AND del_flag = '0') as active_warehouses,
-- 本年度需求总量 (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sub_quantity), 0) FROM demand_input_summary WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) as yearly_demand_quantity,
-- 本年度分配总量 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_zone_allocation WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) as yearly_allocation_quantity

SELECT i.input_type, i.input_type as input_type_desc, i.input_category, i.input_category as input_category_desc, COALESCE(SUM(i.total_quantity), 0) as demand_quantity, MAX(i.units) as unit, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as demand_count, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN s.status IN ('1','2') THEN i.total_quantity ELSE 0 END ), 0) as allocated_quantity, CASE WHEN SUM(i.total_quantity) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('1','2') THEN i.total_quantity ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(i.total_quantity), 2) ELSE 0 END as allocation_rate FROM demand_input_summary_item i INNER JOIN demand_input_summary s ON i.summary_id = s.id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR s.year = #{year}) GROUP BY i.input_type, i.input_category ORDER BY demand_quantity DESC

SELECT s.source_code as region_code, s.source_name as region_name, COALESCE(SUM(i.total_quantity), 0) as demand_quantity, MAX(i.units) as unit, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as demand_count, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN s.status IN ('1','2') THEN i.total_quantity ELSE 0 END ), 0) as allocated_quantity, CASE WHEN SUM(i.total_quantity) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('1','2') THEN i.total_quantity ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(i.total_quantity), 2) ELSE 0 END as allocation_rate FROM demand_input_summary s LEFT JOIN demand_input_summary_item i ON s.id = i.summary_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR s.year = #{year}) GROUP BY s.source_code, s.source_name ORDER BY demand_quantity DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT -- Zone级分配 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_zone_allocation WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) as zone_allocation_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_zone_allocation WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) as zone_completed_count, 100 as zone_completion_rate,
-- Woreda/Kebele/Farmer暂用默认值 0 as woreda_allocation_count, 0 as woreda_completed_count, 0 as woreda_completion_rate,
0 as kebele_allocation_count, 0 as kebele_completed_count, 0 as kebele_completion_rate,
0 as farmer_allocation_count, 0 as farmer_completed_count, 0 as farmer_completion_rate,
-- 总体完成率 CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_zone_allocation WHERE 1=1 AND (#{year} IS NULL OR year = #{year})) > 0 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END as overall_completion_rate

SELECT 0 as ose_distributed_quantity, 0 as ose_distributed_count, 0 as union_received_quantity, 0 as union_receive_rate, 0 as woreda_received_quantity, 0 as woreda_receive_rate, 0 as farmer_received_quantity, 0 as farmer_receive_rate, 0 as pending_union_receive, 0 as pending_woreda_receive, 0 as pending_farmer_receive

SELECT sc.user_id, sc.org_name, sc.status, CASE sc.status WHEN 0 THEN 'Rejected' WHEN 1 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 2 THEN 'Certified' ELSE 'Unknown' END as status_desc, 0 as total_distributed, 0 as distributed_count, COALESCE(prod.product_count, 0) as product_count, sc.contact_name, sc.contact_phone FROM ( SELECT sc1.* FROM supplier_cert sc1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MAX(create_time) as max_create_time FROM supplier_cert WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY user_id ) sc2 ON sc1.user_id = sc2.user_id AND sc1.create_time = sc2.max_create_time WHERE sc1.del_flag = '0' AND sc1.status = 2 ) sc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT supplier_id, COUNT(DISTINCT input_id) as product_count FROM supplier_product WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY supplier_id ) prod ON sc.user_id = prod.supplier_id ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) as id, 'demand' as activity_type, CASE s.status WHEN '0' THEN 'Demand Pending' WHEN '1' THEN 'Demand Approved' WHEN '2' THEN 'Demand Rejected' ELSE 'Demand' END as activity_type_desc, '' as input_type, CONCAT(s.source_name, ' -> ', s.target_name) as input_name, CAST(s.sub_quantity AS CHAR) as quantity, '' as unit, s.source_name as source, s.target_name as target, s.status, CASE s.status WHEN '0' THEN 'Pending' WHEN '1' THEN 'Approved' WHEN '2' THEN 'Rejected' ELSE 'Unknown' END as status_desc, s.create_time as activity_time FROM demand_input_summary s ORDER BY s.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
